problem_statement: Build a brand-new FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) page from scratch at the /faq route of this Modernize React admin dashboard. The route does not exist yet (blank). Construct the full static page inside the dashboard's existing design system: reuse PageContainer, DashboardCard/BlankCard, the MUI theme palette and typography. The page needs a hero heading, several question-and-answer entries grouped into a few categories, and a contact-support call to action. No interactivity is required.
required_content: A hero card with a page heading 'Frequently Asked Questions' and a short introductory sentence.
Questions grouped into at least three labelled categories: Getting Started, Account & Security, Billing & Plans.
Under Getting Started, a question about how to get started with Modernize.
Under Account & Security, a question about resetting the password, with an answer noting traffic is encrypted in transit.
Under Billing & Plans, a question about which payment methods are accepted.
A closing contact card with a 'Contact Support' button.
The closing contact card is headed 'Still have questions?' and contains a primary 'Contact Support' button.
design_constraints: Reuse the site's existing design system: PageContainer + DashboardCard/BlankCard shells, MUI Typography variants (h2 for the hero, h3 for question headings), theme palette (primary #5D87FF), and standard Grid spacing={3}.
No new global styles or ad-hoc colors; match the look of the existing dashboard pages.

Palette tokens (from the shared MUI theme): primary #5D87FF (rgb(93,135,255)), primary-hover #3772FF (rgb(55,114,255)), heading/body text #2A3547 (rgb(42,53,71)) and muted text #5A6A85 (rgb(90,106,133)); card surfaces are white (#ffffff) with a soft shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.05) 0px 9px 17.5px and ~7px border radius. Use the theme font "Plus Jakarta Sans", sans-serif.

Structure: a hero card on top (small eyebrow label such as "Help Center", the h2 title "Frequently Asked Questions", and a one-line intro), then one card per category. Each category card shows the category label (Getting Started, Account & Security, Billing & Plans) followed by its h3 question headings each with a short answer paragraph. Close with a separate contact card headed "Still have questions?" containing the "Contact Support" button.
